preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in permutation)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation must be a distinct integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of subsequences k must be at least 1 and at most f(n).

postconditions.expression: all(len(subsequence) == l_i for subsequence, l_i in zip(subsequences, lengths))
postconditions.description: Each subsequence must have the length specified by l_i.

postconditions.expression: all(all(subsequence[i] <= subsequence[i+1] for i in range(len(subsequence)-1)) or all(subsequence[i] >= subsequence[i+1] for i in range(len(subsequence)-1)) for subsequence in subsequences)
postconditions.description: Each subsequence must be either increasing or decreasing.
